subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She ______ why I had not sent her an invitation.
solution:
The correct answer is 'enquired'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• granted - agree to give or allow (something requested) to.
 
• enquired - ask for information from someone.
 
• desired - strongly wish for or want (something).
 
• denied - state that one refuses to admit the truth or existence of.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would represent the person (she) asking the subject (I) something. 
 
• Hence, enquired is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 
• So, option 2 is the correct answer. 

Correct sentence__ - *She **__enquired__ **why I had not sent her an invitation.*
